name: Notice of Extension of Time for Records Request
description: Written notice that the request is under review, the reason an extension is needed, the expected response date, and estimated fees.
deadline: within five (5) business days of receipt of the request
quote: If the Open Records Officer determines that an extension of time is required to respond to a request, in accordance with the factors stated in law, written notice shall be sent within five (5) business days of receipt of the request.
